As a Program Manager (Deputy Division Administrator), you will: Participates with the Division Administrator in developing and implementing Federal-aid oversight initiatives and stewardship functions through an annual risk assessment of the State's Federal-aid program.

Manages process reviews to improve and enhance project and program decision-making. Recommends quality improvements in division office delivery systems for transportation projects.

Provides program expertise to State and local government officials and engineers to ensure effective program delivery in accordance with Title 23 and related applicable Federal laws.

Direct a multi-disciplinary staff, through subordinate supervisors and team leaders, in providing responsible program and project delivery, technical assistance, and training in the administration of the Federal-aid highway program.

Develop and implement standard operating procedures, manuals and guidance documents for staff to ensure consistent and efficient program delivery. Communicates organizational strategies, goals, objectives and priorities to internal and external audiences. Builds cohesive coalitions and partnerships with State and local officials.

Create and utilize assessment tools to develop, coordinate, implement, and track the Division's Annual Performance Plan. The ideal candidate for this position will have broad knowledge of the Federal-aid Highway Program.

Diverse experience in all aspects of transportation project development from planning through construction, and experience leading a team of transportation professionals. The candidate will also have several years of experience with Federal-aid or Federal Lands Highway program management.
To meet the minimum qualifications for this position, you must meet the specialized experience qualifications for the grade at which you are requesting consideration.

To qualify for the Grade 14, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equal or equivalent to the GS-13, it must include: Experience performing program management principles and practices relating to Federal-aid surface transportation programs, such as providing technical assistance and guidance to state DOTs and local agencies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of program and project delivery, determining eligibility and authorizing expenditure of federal-aid funds, and ensuring compliance with applicable Title 23 and 49 regulations.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSAs): Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Administration and Management - Knowledge of planning, coordination, and execution of business functions, resource allocation, and production.

Compliance - Knowledge of procedures for assessing, evaluating, and monitoring programs or projects for compliance with Federal laws, regulations, and guidance.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Developing Others - Develops the ability of others to perform and contribute to the organization by providing ongoing feedback and by providing opportunities to learn through formal and informal methods. Leadership - Influences, motivates, and challenges others; adapts leadership styles to a variety of situations.

For all types of consideration, experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

For additional information about applying to Federal positions, please click on the following link: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-policies/#url=e4 All applicants must meet all qualification requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

This is a remote position. Location: Remote — South Africa Note: This is a position with Haldren and not with one of its clients. About the Role We are looking for a Market Research Project Manager to own a research capability end to end, from scoping a request through to a finished, decision-ready output.

The role also involves establishing the processes, templates, and documentation this function relies on, which the successful candidate will then own and maintain. The work spans company, market, and competitive research, feeding directly into business decisions and client engagements.

Key Responsibilities Scope research requests, plan the approach, and see them through from first question to finished brief
Research and verify information on companies, sectors, and markets, across a range of business topics
Sustain ongoing tracking of relevant developments over time
Turn raw findings into clear, structured written briefs and summaries, translating facts into useful business insight
Support company, market, and competitive intelligence relevant to the firm’s core work
Maintain research files and reference materials for future use
Handle ad hoc research requests with strong accuracy and good turnaround
Help set up and refine the research function’s workflows, templates, and documentation as it takes shape
Requirements Genuine, hands-on experience in market or business research (a background in competitive intelligence, strategy/commercial research, or a related analytical field is a plus, not a substitute)
Demonstrated ability to research and verify information from multiple sources, quickly and accurately
Demonstrated ability to produce a clean, structured, decision-ready brief
Fluency with research databases, company/industry data sources, and standard spreadsheet/office tools
Strong written English and clear presentation of findings
Comfortable managing multiple research requests and shifting priorities
Able to independently scope and structure a body of research work without close supervision
Nice to Have Familiarity with professional services, recruitment, or consulting environments
Strong Excel or Google Sheets capability
Experience preparing slides, summaries, or briefing materials

· Remote work arrangement
· Opportunities for professional growth Flat management structure with direct access to decision-makers

· Open communication environment About Haldren Haldren is a recruitment agency that provides services to clients ranging from startups and non-profits to multinational corporations. The firm emphasises ethical search processes, attentive candidate care, and leadership placements that support long-term client outcomes. Join the Global Transformation Team at Foundever , where we are seeking two energized and motivated individuals to strengthen our Project Management expertise. We take pride in structuring complex topics and breaking them down for diverse stakeholder groups, both internally and externally.

Position Overview: As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering initiatives within the Global Transformation Programme, as well as other key projects across Foundever .

Your role will be crucial in ensuring projects are completed successfully, within scope, on time, and on budget, all while supporting Foundever ’s transformation and continuous improvement efforts. Key Responsibilities:
Lead the end-to-end management of projects within the Global Transformation Programme and other strategic initiatives.
Develop, monitor, and adjust comprehensive project plans to ensure alignment with project goals and organizational priorities.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and accountability to achieve project milestones.
Identify and mitigate project risks, proactively addressing issues to minimize their impact.
Provide regular and transparent updates to stakeholders at all levels, effectively communicating progress, challenges, and outcomes.
Promote and implement best practices in project management, capturing and disseminating lessons learned.
Ensure all projects adhere to Foundever ’s policies, procedures, and quality standards.
Support change management activities to enhance the adoption of new processes, technologies, or ways of working.
Facilitate project meetings and workshops, ensuring effective documentation and follow-up on action items.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, or a related field.
Minimum of 2 years of Project Management experience.
Proven track record in managing diverse projects, particularly in transformation, process improvement, or technology initiatives.
Strong leadership, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills.
Proficient in project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, MS Project, Asana, Trello).
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or similar) is a plus.
Change management experience or certification is advantageous.

You will serve as a General Engineer Program Manager Program Manager and be responsible for supporting a variety of engineering and planning assignments/projects involving the architectural, civil, industrial, mechanical, environmental, electrical, urban planning, space planning, and systems engineering disciplines.

This position will have to coordinate with headquarters project stakeholders/sponsors and align operational requirements documentation with technical requirements documentation, such as configuration and space standards. Being a Coast Guard civilian makes you a valuable member of the Coast Guard team.

Typical work assignments include: Coordinate with operational and program offices on infrastructure requirements documentation to support the development, planning, prioritization, and execution of US Coast Guard shore facility projects.

Review and evaluate shore infrastructure standards, technical orders, and planning guidance to ensure facility documentation is accurate, aligned with regulations, and supports project analysis and decision-making.

Analyze and validate project needs requests and planning documents to determine technical feasibility, cost effectiveness, compliance, and alignment with operational and mission requirements.

Investigate and resolve infrastructure planning and engineering issues involving USCG real property, construction, renovation, and sustainment projects to support effective project execution and long-term asset management.

Prepare and present technical reports, briefings, recommendations, and project updates to management officials, stakeholders, and project teams to support infrastructure planning, policy development, and project approval decisions.

Reasonable Accommodation (RA) Requests: If you believe you have a disability (i.e., physical or mental), covered by the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 as amended that would interfere with completing the USA Hire Competency Based Assessments, you will be granted the opportunity to request a RA in your online application.

Basic Requirements: This position has a positive Education Requirement in addition to at least one year of Specialized Experience or substitution of education for experience or combination (if applicable) in order to be found minimally qualified. Transcripts must be submitted with your application package.

You MUST meet the following requirements: EDUCATION: A.

Degree: Engineering - To be acceptable, the program must: (1) lead to a bachelor's degree in a school of engineering with at least one program accredited by ABET; or (2) include differential and integral calculus and courses (more advanced than first-year physics and chemistry) in five of the following seven areas of engineering science or physics: (a) statics, dynamics; (b) strength of materials (stress-strain relationships); (c) fluid mechanics, hydraulics; (d) thermodynamics; (e) electrical fields and circuits; (f) nature and properties of materials (relating particle and aggregate structure to properties); and (g) any other comparable area of fundamental engineering science or physics, such as optics, heat transfer, soil mechanics, or electronics.

OR B.

Combination of education and experience -- college-level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the physical and mathematical sciences underlying engineering, and (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the engineering sciences and techniques and their applications to one of the branches of engineering.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by one of the following: Professional registration or licensure -- Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT), or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico.

Absent other means of qualifying under this standard, those applicants who achieved such registration by means other than written test (e.g., State grandfather or eminence provisions) are eligible only for positions that are within or closely related to the specialty field of their registration.

For example, an applicant who attains registration through a State Board's eminence provision as a manufacturing engineer typically would be rated eligible only for manufacturing engineering positions.

Written Test -- Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) examination or any other written test required for professional registration by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, and Puerto Rico.

Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, and engineering sciences and that included the courses specified in the basic requirements under paragraph A.

The courses must be fully acceptable toward meeting the requirements of an engineering program as described in paragraph A.

Related curriculum -- Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor's degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance.

Ordinarily there should be either an established plan of intensive training to develop professional engineering competence, or several years of prior professional engineering-type experience, e.g., in interdisciplinary positions.

(The above examples of related curricula are not all inclusive.) AND To qualify at the GS-13 grade level, your resume must demonstrate at least one (1) full year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-12 grade level in the federal sector.

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the ability, skill, and knowledge to successfully perform the duties of this position and is typically in or related to this line of work. Examples of specialized experience include performing the following types of tasks on a regular basis.

Specialized experience must include the following: Reviewing and processing purchase requests, contract documents, or procurement actions to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with policies and procedures.

Coordinating with customers, vendors, contractors, or program offices to gather requirements, resolve issues, and support purchasing or project activities. Analyzing documents, data, or requests to identify discrepancies, determine requirements, and recommend appropriate solutions or corrective actions.

Reviewing regulations, technical guidance, or operating procedures to ensure purchases, projects, or administrative actions comply with applicable standards and requirements.

Preparing reports, correspondence, estimates, spreadsheets, or briefings to communicate procurement status, project information, or recommendations to management and stakeholders.

NOTE: All experience statements (i.e., duties, specialized experience, or related applicable assessment) copied from this announcement and pasted into your resume will not be considered as a demonstration of your qualifications for this position. NOTE: Education can not be substituted for experience at this grade level.

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

This position is for the Junction City, KS as their duty location. Provides comprehensive operational oversight and coordination for Junction City, Iola, and Lawrence VA Clinics, ensuring efficient day-to-day functioning and continuous improvement of clinical and administrative operations.

Evaluates outpatient service delivery models and develops recommendations to improve access, efficiency, and patient experience within assigned clinics and market areas.

Supports the delivery of high-quality, accessible, cost-effective health care services by coordinating resources, workflow processes, access initiatives, and support functions across multiple clinical disciplines to promote efficient clinic operations, timely access to care, and effective utilization of available resources. .

Leads and supports advanced analytical studies to evaluate clinical workload trends, patient flow, scheduling practices, and capacity management across assigned clinics. Uses data-driven methodologies to identify inefficiencies, forecast demand, and recommend organizational improvements.

Optimizes provider and care team scheduling by assessing clinic grid utilization, supply demand alignment, face to face and virtual visit distributions, staffing acuity, and clinical productivity indicators. Evaluates the impact of Community Care referrals on internal capacity, access to care, patient wait times, and care continuity.

Collaborates with clinical leaders to rebalance services between VA-delivered care, virtual modalities, and purchased care when appropriate.

Leads efforts to improve patient workflows by partnering with Primary Care, Mental Health, Specialty Care, and Nursing leadership to evaluate room utilization, care team composition, visit modality mix, appointment cycle times, and bottlenecks impacting throughput.

Develop operational solutions such as standardized workflows, enhanced scheduling procedures, process redesign, escalation pathways, and care coordination practices to enhance access and patient experience. Identifies and implements improvements to optimize clinic management processes and access strategies.

Standardizes, implements, and sustains key operational and business processes, including scheduling practices, to support efficient clinic operations and enhance the Veteran experience Incorporates remote healthcare considerations, including telehealth demand, virtual care readiness, space requirements for telehealth operations, and staffing support, to ensure seamless integration of virtual modalities into clinic operations.

Conducts analyses of telehealth utilization patterns, no show rates, broadband limitations, and patient adoption trends to support operational decision-making and service delivery planning.

Administers management reporting systems and dashboards to support data informed decision making related to organizational performance, staffing models, access metrics, quality indicators, and workload distribution.

Develops and coordinates quality assurance and performance improvement activities ensuring compliance with accrediting and regulatory bodies (e.g., Joint Commission, OIG, CARF). The HSS measures and assesses clinical business activities with an emphasis on improving clinical product line performance.

The HSS is responsible for regularly presenting key management indicators to the Executive Staff. Integrates administrative services-including Finance, HR, Acquisition, Facilities, Environmental of Care, and Health Administration Service-in support of clinic goals and market objectives.

Resolves complex operational, personnel, and cross service issues that impact patient care, staff performance, and organizational effectiveness. Provides leadership during change management initiatives, operational disruptions, and emergent contingencies that affect clinic operations.

The incumbent collaborates closely with key clinical leadership officials as an impartial facilitator in addressing disagreements related to scheduling practices, workload distribution, resource prioritization, and workflow redesign.

Employs conflict resolution strategies, mediation techniques, and interest-based problem solving to ensure concerns are addressed objectively, respectfully, and in alignment with EKHCS policies and organizational values.

To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement, 09/04/2026. Time-In-Grade Requirement: Applicants who are current Federal employees and have held a GS grade any time in the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

For a GS-12 position you must have served 52 weeks at the GS-11. The grade may have been in any occupation, but must have been held in the Federal service. An SF-50 that shows your time-in-grade eligibility must be submitted with your application materials.

If the most recent SF-50 has an effective date within the past year, it may not clearly demonstrate you possess one-year time-in-grade, as required by the announcement. In this instance, you must provide an additional SF-50 that clearly demonstrates one-year time-in-grade.

Note: Time-In-Grade requirements also apply to former Federal employees applying for reinstatement as well as current employees applying for Veterans Employment Opportunities Act of 1998 (VEOA) appointment.

You may qualify based on your experience and/or education as described below: Individual Occupational Requirement (IOR): An IOR is a basic requirement that must be met in order to qualify for entry into this job series and it is something that can't be waived.

To qualify for the GS 0671 occupational series, applicants MUST possess one of the following: (for positions above GS-5): Progressively responsible analytical or administrative, or clinical management or supervisory experience in the health care field.

This work may have been performed in an operating health care facility or a higher organizational echelon with advisory or directional authority over such facilities.

Work must have involved a close working relationship with facility managers and analysis and/or coordination of administrative, clinical, or other service activities, and provided knowledge of the following: Missions, organizations, programs, and requirements of health care delivery systems; Regulations and standards of various regulatory and credentialing groups; and Government-wide, agency, and facility systems and requirements in various administrative areas such as budget, personnel, and procurement.

In addition to the individual occupational requirement, you must meet the specialized experience for the position as well:GS-12 Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade GS-11 in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Demonstrated mastery in applying analytical and evaluative methods and techniques to issues or studies concerning the efficiency and effectiveness of agency and program operations.

Expert knowledge of pertinent laws, regulations, policies and precedents, major issues, program goals and objectives, work processes, and administrative operations which affect the administration of GBO program and committee functions.

Mastery of VHA organization structure and operations to support VHA-wide assessments to improve the VHA system for health care. Expert knowledge of missions, organizations, programs, and requirements of health care delivery systems in general and in the country at large.

Excellent interpersonal skills to facilitate and coordinate vast needs for communications and information, between and among the stakeholders, including the Department, VHACO, VISNs, facilities and non-VA groups.

For more information on these qualification standards, please visit the United States Office of Personnel Management's website at https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/.

Job Title: Senior Delivery Manager Mode: Remote (CANADA or US) Salary – up to 155K CAD / up to USD 130k Experience- 10+ years Job Description: We are seeking a Senior Delivery Manager to lead large-scale Analytics & Data Management programs for marquee clients in our Sports & Gaming practice.

This role combines delivery excellence, stakeholder management, team leadership, and account growth, with a strong emphasis on best practices, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate should bring deep experience in data & analytics delivery, strong analytical skills, and the ability to mine new opportunities within existing accounts while ensuring high team morale and predictable outcomes.

The incumbent will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, and delivery teams to drive best practices, ensure consistently best quality output across the board, and endeavor to improve the current state. Key Responsibilities: 1. Delivery Leadership
Own end-to-end delivery of analytics and data management engagements, ensuring scope, timelines, quality, and cost targets are met.
Establish and enforce delivery best practices, governance models, and execution frameworks across programs.
Manage complex, multi-workstream programs and projects involving data engineering, data platforms, and analytics solutions.
Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks; drive structured problem-solving and mitigation plans.
2. Stakeholder & Client Management
Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, ensuring transparency, alignment, and value realization.
Lead executive-level reviews, steering committee meetings, and roadmap discussions.
Balance client expectations with internal capabilities to ensure sustainable delivery.
3. Team Leadership & Talent Development
Build, manage, and scale large, globally distributed teams across geographies.
Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement, and high team satisfaction.
Mentor delivery managers, tech leads, and high-potential talent; support career growth and succession planning.
4. Analytics, Data & Technology Oversight Provide delivery leadership for solutions involving:
Data Management & Data Engineering
Cloud-based analytics platforms
Data warehousing and modern data stacks

AWS Cloud, including AWS Redshift
SQL and Python (hands-on not mandatory, but must be delivery-fluent)
Collaborate with architects and engineering leads to ensure scalable, secure, and performant solutions. 5. Account Growth & Organic Business Development
Drive organic growth within existing accounts by identifying white-space opportunities and unmet client needs.
Partner with sales and leadership to support account growth targets, proposals, and solution shaping.
Lead opportunity mining, effort estimation, and delivery approach definition for new initiatives.
Contribute to long-term account strategy and roadmap planning.

10-12 years of experience in delivery, program, or project management within analytics, data management, or data engineering domains.
Proven experience managing large, global, cross-functional teams.
Strong understanding of data management and data engineering ecosystems.
Strong experience with AWS or other cloud data ecosystems (Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, GCP).
Hands-on familiarity with SQL & Python
Experience with Agile delivery and project management tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps, etc.).
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, data-driven mindset.
Experience with data clean room solutions, consent platforms, DataOps exposure (data observability, DQ frameworks, lineage, incident management, and SLO/SLA governance), software/application development delivery (frontend, backend, API management, and design/UX collaboration), SDLC practices (CI/CD)
Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive presence.
Demonstrated success in account mining, organic BD, and supporting revenue growth.

Ability to balance strategic project management with technical understanding.
Experience working with Fortune 500 or global enterprise clients.
Passion for sports, fan engagement, or DTC business models.

Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management abilities.
Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills.

Leadership - Influences, motivates, and challenges others; adapts leadership styles to a variety of situations.

For all types of consideration, experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Allocated Bullion Exchange (ABX)
Allocated Bullion Exchange (ABX) is the world’s leading electronic institutional exchange for allocated physical precious metals. The ABX brings global trading, price discovery, and clearing facilities into one standardised and secure online trading environment via our groundbreaking exchange trading platform, MetalDesk.
The exchange introduces a new, centrally cleared, transparent, and cost-effective allocated exchange system and standard for the industry by offering precious metal market participants an exchange where they are able to trade, deliver, or store physical precious metal in 7 global locations.

ABX gives market participants across the world direct access to one integrated and consolidated global wholesale bullion market. We have enhanced market efficiency, introduced inclusiveness and accessibility, and provided relevant real-time price discovery.
ABX has modernised, globalised, & Integrated the precious metal markets by redefining the way physical bullion is traded. We connect all major global liquidity centres and break down the barriers to entry to the global wholesale market for all market participants.

# Manager:in digitale Kanäle 80 - 100% #
Suchst du eine Herausforderung im Umfeld von Politik und Verwaltung, am digitalen Puls der Zeit, bei einer Arbeitgeberin mit Themen so vielfältig wie das Leben?
Die Direktion der Justiz und des Innern (JI) erfüllt eine Vielfalt von Aufgaben, von A wie Archivwesen bis Z wie Zivilstandswesen. Bei uns im Generalsekretariat laufen die Fäden zusammen. Wir unterstützen die Direktionsvorsteherin und unsere Einheiten, bearbeiten Querschnittsthemen und begleiten und führen Programme und Projekte.
Im Januar 2027 tritt das revidierte Verwaltungsrechtspflegegesetz in Kraft, das vorsieht, dass Verwaltungsverfahren neu auch digital über spezielle elektronische Kanäle abgewickelt werden. Mit RRB Nr. 433/2026 wurde ein wichtiger Meilenstein für die Implementierung dieser elektronischen Kanäle im Kanton Zürich erreicht: Im Projekt VRGo wird die neue technische Lösung «VerfahrenZH» aufgebaut, welche die rechtskonforme Abwicklung von Verwaltungsverfahren ermöglicht.
Um den organisationsübergreifenden Aufbau dieser Lösung seitens der JI zu begleiten, und um im Betrieb der Lösung die Anforderungen unserer Verwaltungseinheiten fachgerecht bei den zuständigen Stellen einzubringen, suchen wir per 1. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung im Generalsekretariat eine Person mit technischem Hintergrund als Manager/in digitale Kanäle (80 - 100 %).
### Deine Hauptaufgaben ###
* Du stehst proaktiv im Austausch mit den verfahrensführenden Stellen der JI und identifizierst, koordinierst und priorisierst ihre Anforderungen an die elektronischen Kanäle. Diese bringst du in die Projekte zu deren Weiterentwicklung und in übergreifende Digitalisierungsvorhaben ein.
* Du kennst die relevanten Fachapplikationen der JI und unterstützt allfällige Weiterentwicklungen und Anbindungen in Zusammenhang mit den elektronischen Kanälen.
* Du bist in der JI, im Kanton und im Bund mit den relevanten Stellen vernetzt und über bedeutsame Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden.
* Du berätst und unterstützt die Verwaltungseinheiten der JI bei der weiteren Digitalisierung ihrer Verwaltungsverfahren. Dazu begleitest du die Umsetzung neuer oder weiterentwickelter Funktionalitäten aus Nutzendensicht und stehst in engem Austausch mit den Fachbereichen, Legal, IT-/Betriebsteams und weiteren Stakeholdern.
### Dein Profil ###
* Tertiäre Ausbildung (z.B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Rechtswissenschaften), mit Erfahrung in der Digitalisierung von Prozessen, Dienstleistungen oder Kommunikationskanälen (vorzugsweise in der Verwaltung oder im juristischen Bereich)
* Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse der Nutzenden sowie für serviceorientierte Gestaltung, stark in Koordination und Stakeholder-Management
* Schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie eine analytische, strukturierte und konzeptionelle Arbeitsweise mit Freude an der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Lösungen
* Ganzheitliches Denken, hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative und hohe Eigenverantwortung mit proaktivem Arbeitsverständnis
### Unser Angebot ###
* Eine vielseitige und sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem motivierten Team
* Gelebte flache Hierarchien und flexible Home-Office-Regelungen
* Spannende Einblicke in die vielseitigen Tätigkeiten unserer Einheiten
* Ein Arbeitsort direkt am Hauptbahnhof
* Die Stelle ist in Lohnklasse 20 eingereiht (Informationen zum Lohnsystem).
### Bewerbung ###
Schick uns deine Bewerbung direkt über unser Online-Tool (für diese Stelle berücksichtigen wir keine Bewerbungen über Personaldienstleistungsunternehmen). Bei Fragen zur Stelle kannst du dich gerne an Samuel Klaus, Leiter Recht Digital, wenden (043 259 25 43, samuel.klaus@ji.zh.ch).

## Your Purpose ##
Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping the customer journey and guest experience aboard our new ships?
We are looking for a Newbuild Experience Development & Delivery Manager to join our team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Experience Development & Delivery.
This role is designed for someone who can cut through complexity, uncover the real challenges behind ambiguous situations, and reframe them into guest-centric experiences that can be brought to life within the physical environment of our ships. You are able to connect customer needs, operational realities, and business objectives, transforming ideas into clear, actionable concepts and deliverables.
Working closely with stakeholders across Hotel Operations, F&B, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Architecture, and Design, you will help define, develop, and deliver future guest experiences from concept through execution. You will ensure that every solution is insight-driven, operationally feasible, and aligned with our brand vision and strategic objectives.
Success in this role requires strong understanding of the customer journey, intellectual curiosity, and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively. You are a trusted partner who can influence diverse stakeholders, elevate the quality of thinking around you, and bring clarity, structure, and momentum to complex projects.

**Project Management**
* Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure progress and alignment.
* Elevate issues early and propose mitigation scenarios.
**Strategic Support & Thought Partnership**
* Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.
* Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation.
* Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for înternal conversations.
**Narrative Building & Deliverables Presentation**
* Craft clear, concise, and strategically sound storytelling materials for leadership forums (on Canva, PowerPoint of other design tools).
* Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.
**Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* Engage with Hotel Operations, F&B, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Architects, and Designers teams to gather insights and shape concepts.
* Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.
* Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.
## Your Journey so far ##
* 5-8 years in strategy, innovation, business design, consulting, or strategic project management.
* Experience in hospitality, cruise, retail, consumer goods, or guest experience is a strong plus.
* Strong background in designing and executing guest-focused experiences, from concept to delivery.
* A balance of creativity and operational know-how, able to dream big and deliver practically.
* Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional teams (operations, creative, marketing, sales, revenue, communications), with the ability to unite diverse perspectives around a single vision.
* Excellent knowledge of modern visual communication tools (Canva, Adobe Suite, AI-driven creative platforms) to produce compelling visual documents and storytelling assets beyond traditional slide decks.
* Excellent relationship-building skills; able to inspire, influence, and connect across diverse teams.
* Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with confidence at the executive level.Ability to travel 20-30% of the time.Fluent English; additional languages a plus.
* EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Wer wir sind
creativestyle ist eine E-Commerce-Agentur mit deutsch-polnischem Setup: Projektmanagement in München, Entwicklung in Krakau und Rybnik. Über 120 umgesetzte Shops, rund 110 Leute, Kunden wie benuta, NKD, BRAX, CEWE Fotobuch, Einhell, Rieker und Bergzeit.

Jede und jeder bei uns hat einen technischen Background. Die Geschäftsführung eingeschlossen.
50% Freiheit, 50% Verantwortung. Beides gilt gleichzeitig.
Fehler sind bei uns Lektionen, keine Schuldfrage. Wir steigen nur ungern zweimal in denselben Fluss.
Corporate sind wir nicht. Unzuverlässig allerdings auch nicht – und falls du glaubst, dass sich das ausschließt, beweisen wir dir gern das Gegenteil.
Wir nehmen keine Projekte an, auf die wir keine Lust haben. Aufgeräumt wird hier nur, was wir selbst angefangen haben.
Warum wir diese Stelle gerade jetzt besetzen

1. Wir bauen unser PIM- und ERP-Geschäft aus. Ab nächstem Jahr bieten wir Pimcore und Odoo an. Wir suchen jemanden, der diese Projekte nicht nur steuert, sondern Kunden im Workshop schon den Unterschied zwischen sauberem Datenmodell und teurer Migration zeigt.
2. Wir erfinden die PM-Rolle neu: In Zeiten von KI reicht bloßes Tickets-Schreiben nicht mehr – wir sind Innovationstreiber, keine Werkbank! Bei uns geht es um messbaren Impact, echtes Produktdenken und KI-Innovationen. Du steigst also in eine Rolle ein, die du aktiv mitgestalten kannst.
Aufgaben
Deine Mission
Projekte führen – von Anfang bis Betrieb. Du verantwortest Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung großer E-Commerce-Projekte: Discovery, Konzept, Kickoff, Go-live und die Zeit danach. Technisch bewegen wir uns in Shopware, Adobe Commerce / Magento, commercetools, Pimcore und Storyblok.
Der Mensch sein, bei dem alles zusammenläuft. Du bist Hauptansprechpartner*in für unsere deutschsprachigen Kunden und die Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams in Polen. Kundenbedürfnisse übersetzt du in saubere Lösungen, die Ideen des Teams bringst du zurück zum Kunden.
Impact – und zwar messbar. Messbar meinen wir wörtlich: Zu jeder Initiative gehören ein KPI und ein Tracking-Konzept, mit dem sich Vorher und Nachher belegen lassen.
Denken wie ein Product Owner. Behandle das Produkt wie dein eigenes! Wenn dich eine Funktion, ein Design oder eine Priorisierung nicht überzeugt, sprichst du es offen an. Bei unklarem Business Value stoppst du die Umsetzung, bis Klarheit herrscht. Die finale Entscheidung trifft der Kunde, klar – aber blind umgesetzt wird bei uns nichts.
Und der ganz normale Rest. Projektpläne, Timings, Budgets und Status-Reports hältst du zuverlässig auf Kurs. Meetings, Workshops, Sprint-Plannings und Retros moderierst du so, dass hinterher alle wissen, was Sache ist. Risiken erkennst du, bevor sie eins werden.
Deine Spezialisierung: PIM oder ERP
Hier liegt der Unterschied zu einer klassischen PM-Stelle. Eins von beidem bringst du mit:
PIM (Pimcore) – Du weißt, wie Produktdaten wirklich aussehen, bevor sie schön sind: Datenmodelle, Attribute, Varianten, Kanäle, Übersetzungen. Du hast schon mal eine Migration aus einer gewachsenen Excel-Landschaft begleitet und danach trotzdem noch an das Projekt geglaubt.
ERP (Odoo) – Bestände, Preise, Aufträge, Rechnungen, Schnittstellen. Du kannst einschätzen, was ins ERP gehört, was in den Shop und was besser in keins von beidem.
Beides mitzubringen wäre Angeberei – wir hätten aber nichts dagegen.
Du kommst aus einer vergleichbaren Welt, nur mit anderen Systemen (Akeneo, Contentserv, SAP, Business Central)? Dann sprich uns trotzdem an. Uns interessiert, ob du die Zusammenhänge verstehst, nicht welches Logo auf dem Login-Screen war.
Qualifikation
Du bist unser Mensch, wenn
Du mindestens 3 Jahre Projekte im digitalen Umfeld oder im E-Commerce geführt hast – von der ersten Idee bis in den Betrieb.
Du technisch mitreden kannst: APIs, PIM, ERP, Schnittstellen. Selbst programmieren musst du nicht. Verstehen, worüber die Devs gerade streiten, schon.
Scrum und Kanban dein Handwerkszeug sind und du Jira, Confluence und Miro im Schlaf bedienst.
Du fließend Deutsch (C2) und sehr gut Englisch sprichst – unsere Kunden sitzen im DACH-Raum, unsere Teams in Polen.
Du zwischen den Zeilen liest und Bedürfnisse erkennst, bevor sie im Briefing stehen.
Du aus einem leeren Blatt eine Roadmap machst: Backlog, Milestones, Budget, Timing.
Du KI-Tools schon im Alltag nutzt – oder große Lust hast, das in den nächsten Monaten zu ändern.
Du auch dann noch weißt, was zu tun ist, wenn der Deadline morgen und das Problem heute ist.
Pluspunkte sammelst du mit Erfahrung auf Händlerseite und mit Shopware und/oder Magento.
Wir bauen ein offenes Team. Bewirb dich unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Orientierung, Religion oder Behinderung – uns interessiert, was du kannst und wie du denkst.

Was du bei uns bekommst
70.000 – 85.000 € , abhängig von Erfahrung und Spezialisierung. Konkrete Zahlen gibt es beim ersten Gespräch, nicht erst nach der dritten Runde.
Innovationsbudget für PoCs und eigene Ideen – bewusst als Investment gedacht, nicht als Restposten.
Weiterbildungsbudget inklusive Zertifizierungen (z. B. Shopware, Pimcore, …).
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office. Die Arbeit passt sich deinem Leben an, nicht umgekehrt.
Büro mit Dachterrasse im TRI München – plus MVV-Ticket, damit du auch hinkommst.
MacBook Pro und iPhone, ordentliche Peripherie inklusive.
Teamevents in Deutschland und Polen. Epische Trips nach Polen und die legendäre Revanche der polnischen Crew auf der Wiesn – eine Tradition mit Erfolgsgarantie!
Kaffee, Getränke und Obst. Muss man ja heute dazuschreiben.
Klingt nach dir?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique
At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually.

From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges.

Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

As an Onboarding Project Manager, you will lead complex onboarding projects for Cloudbeds ’ mid-market customers, guiding them from contract signature through adoption and successful transition to Account Management at the time onboarding is completed.

Acting as the strategic lead throughout the onboarding journey, you will partner cross-functionally with Onboarding, Account Management, Sales, Product, Support, and Professional Services teams to deliver a seamless implementation experience that drives customer confidence, platform adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
You will play a critical role in ensuring customers realize value quickly by managing timelines, aligning stakeholders, mitigating risks, and maintaining a high-touch customer experience. This role combines project management, customer partnership and relationship management, operational excellence, and hospitality expertise in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

Our team is passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and helping hoteliers succeed with Cloudbeds from day one. We build together, review opportunities together, and embrace a test-and-learn mindset that encourages innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Every team member is valued and empowered to share feedback, ideas, and insights so we can learn, grow, and improve both as individuals and as a team.

Team members who thrive here are proactive communicators, collaborative problem-solvers, and true customer advocates who enjoy navigating complexity while working closely with others to drive successful outcomes.

s.h: What You Bring to the Team
s.t:
Own and manage the end-to-end onboarding lifecycle for mid-market customers, from sales handoff through go-live, adoption, and transition to Account Management
Define project scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables to ensure successful and timely implementations
Serve as the primary point of contact for onboarding mid-market customers, driving clear communication and stakeholder alignment throughout the project lifecycle
Lead customer meetings, including pre-kickoff, kickoff, project check-ins, and go-live milestones, while documenting action items and next steps
Proactively identify and manage risks, dependencies, and escalation points to maintain project momentum and customer satisfaction
Coordinate cross-functional collaboration across Sales, Onboarding, Product, Support, Professional Services, and Account Management teams
Monitor onboarding success metrics, customer adoption, training completion, and utilization milestones to support long-term customer success

# Abteilungsleiter/in Gesamtmobilität 80 - 100% #
Wollen Sie das Verkehrssystem im Kanton Zürich ganzheitlich und langfristig weiterentwickeln? In der Abteilung Gesamtmobilität des Amts für Mobilität planen wir das künftige Verkehrssystem über alle Verkehrsträger und Verkehrsmittel hinweg.

Wir entwickeln in Abstimmung mit Siedlung und Umwelt Gesamtverkehrskonzepte, erarbeiten die Agglomerationsprogramme und koordinieren deren Umsetzung. Auch für Fragen des Güterverkehrs und der Logistik sind wir die zentrale, koordinierende Stelle. In der Richtplanung bearbeiten wir alle Verkehrsthemen und prägen diese massgeblich mit.

Entscheidend ist dabei stets die Gesamtsicht - so schaffen wir die planerischen Grundlagen für eine zukunftsorientierte Mobilität im Kanton Zürich.
Wir suchen Sie per 1. Juni 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung als Leiter/-in Gesamtmobilität.
### Ihre Hauptaufgaben ###
* Führung der Abteilung Gesamtmobilität mit insgesamt zehn Mitarbeitenden sowie deren fachliche, personelle und organisatorische Weiterentwicklung
* Verantwortung für die strategischen Gesamtverkehrsplanungen des Kantons Zürich sowie Leitung bedeutender Planungsprojekte wie Agglomerationsprogramme, regionale Gesamtverkehrskonzepte und Gebietsplanungen
* Vertretung der gesamtverkehrlichen Interessen des Kantons in Richt-, Nutzungs- und Sachplanungsverfahren sowie gegenüber Verwaltung, Politik und externen Anspruchsgruppen
* Mitwirkung in der Geschäftsleitung des Amts für Mobilität und Mitverantwortung für dessen strategische Weiterentwicklung
### Unsere Anforderungen ###
* Hochschulabschluss (Master oder Doktorat) in Verkehrsplanung, Raumplanung, Bauingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
* Mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung, idealerweise im Verkehrs- oder Raumplanungsumfeld sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für politische und verwaltungsinterne Prozesse
* Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Verhandlungskompetenz sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen
* Vernetzte und analytische Denkweise, hohe Eigeninitiative sowie Durchsetzungsvermögen
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt, Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
### Unser Angebot ###
Wir bieten Ihnen eine verantwortungsvolle Führungsfunktion mit grossem Gestaltungsspielraum in einem politisch spannenden Umfeld. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem engagierten Team prägen Sie die Mobilitätsentwicklung des Kantons Zürich und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Gestaltung des Verkehrssystems. Es erwarten Sie moderne Anstellungsbedingungen, flexible Arbeitsformen sowie ein zentral gelegener Arbeitsplatz direkt beim Hauptbahnhof Zürich.

MSC Crociere is looking for an **IT Problem Manager**.To manage the end-to-end lifecycle of IT problems, driving structured root cause identification and permanent resolution to reduce recurring incidents and improve the stability of MSC Cruises' mission-critical IT services.

· Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of all IT problems, ensuring timely identification, classification, prioritisation, and formal closure in alignment with business impact.
· Lead and coordinate root cause analysis (RCA) activities using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, Fault Tree Analysis), engaging internal technical teams and external vendors.
· Work with vendors and external service providers to drive problem identification and resolution, ensuring contractual obligations and SLA commitments are met throughout the problem lifecycle.
· Create and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB), ensuring workarounds and confirmed root causes are accurately documented and accessible to all support tiers.
· Coordinate with Change Management and technical owners to ensure controlled adoption of permanent fixes, monitoring progress and escalating where needed.
· Facilitate post-incident reviews (PIRs) following major incidents, ensuring findings are translated into concrete preventive actions tracked to effective closure.
· Perform proactive trend analysis on incident and problem data, producing regular management reporting on problem status, recurring patterns, and service-level trends.
· Actively contribute to the Continuous Service Improvement (CSI) framework by channelling problem management insights into actionable enhancements to IT services and processes.

· 4 to 6 years of proven experience in IT Service Management with direct involvement in Problem Management or Root Cause Analysis in complex, enterprise-scale environments.
· Experience managing vendors and external service providers in the context of problem investigation and service improvement.
· Fluent in English, oral and written; any additional language is an advantage.
· Solid working knowledge of ITSM platforms, with ServiceNow experience required; familiarity with data analysis and reporting tools.
· Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent; ITIL Foundation required, with solid knowledge of Problem, Incident, and Change Management processes; ITIL Practitioner is a strong advantage.
· Proven experience with structured RCA methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, Fault Tree Analysis, Kepner-Tregoe).
· Analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends and systemic issues from large volumes of incident and problem data.
· Effective stakeholder management skills, with a proven track record of driving action and adoption without direct authority.
· Right to work in Italy
